title: Content list page props, contract version 1
description: The props of the panel's content list, Content/List (PRD 5.4, 13.4): the address the logout posts to, the name of the type the page lists or null for every type, the release state of the shared variant the list is filtered by or null for every state, and the read of entry.list as the person: its result, the document of entry.list.result.v1.json the query's result codec wrote at the person's classification access, or the rejection, the problem details (problem.v1.json) of a rejected read, one of the two and never both. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ContentListPage, and the generated codec ContentListPageCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

logout.description: The address the logout posts to.

rejection.description: The problem details of a rejected read, a document of problem.v1.json, or null for an answered read. Validate it with the validator of ProblemV1.

result.description: The result of entry.list, a document of entry.list.result.v1.json as the query's result codec wrote it, or null for a rejected read. Validate it with the validator of EntryListV1.

state.description: The release state of the shared variant the entries listed have, as the address names it, or null for every state.

type.description: The name of the type the page lists, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post, or null for the list across every type.
